text: ok why can i not add a cylinder to my scene
resolution: Diagnosed the initial Add Cylinder symptom against the live editor. The document was active, resident, unclaimed, outside Paint mode, and its visible Outliner range matched its authored-face count; the Add command did reach the shell but the native mesh append returned refusal. The shell retained all existing geometry and surfaced the recovery hint. The user then identified a reproducible edit sequence, which continues under req_3978 using the native Follow recorder to locate the first corrupting transaction.
